subject: MAP: security & retention decision items (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lighthousebank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tanya Singh <tanya.singh@lighthousebank.com>, security@lighthousebank.com

Subject: MAP kickoff — security questionnaire & retention clarifications

Irene / Redwood team,

Thanks for picking this up. As we move toward our evaluation close and procurement, Legal and Security need clarity on a few MAP items so we can sign off on the internal risk review. High level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2 coverage: what systems and deployment modes are in scope (hosted API vs. Dedicated/Private)?
- SIG/CAIQ: we already started a questionnaire (attached). Please mark items that require evidence vs. written answers.
- DPA redlines: our Legal wants confirmation on clauses for data residency, subprocessors, and audit rights.
- Data retention: what are your default retention windows for logs, KV cache, and persisted customer data? Is there an option for a longer archive (7 yrs) or shorter ephemeral mode?

Can we get a one-page MAP (deliverables, owners, dates) that ties these gates to the evaluation close timeline? We’re targeting a PO by end of October, but Legal wants hard cutoffs for evidence ingestion.

I attached our SIG workbook to save time.

Best,
Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform Security, Lighthouse Bank
alex.mercer@lighthousebank.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: Lighthouse_SIG_Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet of CAIQ rows, 120 questions)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lighthousebank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security questionnaire & retention clarifications

Alex — thanks for the clear list and the SIG workbook. I’ve looped in Marcus (AE) and Naomi (security lead) so we can map owners to each MAP gate. Quick response and next steps below: 

Summary answers (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood’s hosted API and control plane are covered by our SOC 2 Type II report (scope: data plane for hosted models, control plane operations). Dedicated and Private deployments can be included under our SOC 2 program but we’ll note differences in the MAP (some evidence is deployment-specific).
- SIG/CAIQ: we’ll go through your spreadsheet and tag each row: (Evidence required / Written response / Not applicable). Expect a completed pass and evidence links in 3 business days.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA and we can accept reasonable redlines around residency and subprocessors. We’ll provide a suggested redline track via DocuSign and flag any mandatory language.
- Data retention: default logs/telemetry retention is 30 days; KV cache is ephemeral (default 0–24 hours depending on workload) but persistent customer-generated artifacts are retained per customer config. We can support extended archival for regulated needs; we need to align on who pays for long-term storage.

Immediate asks:
1) Marcus — can you propose the MAP table (deliverables, owner, target date) and share a spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow?
2) Naomi — please prepare a short SOC 2 evidence pack (pdf) and an initial SIG evidence mapping.
3) Alex/Tanya — confirm which deployment model you plan to evaluate in PoC (hosted vs. dedicated/private) so we can scope evidence.

I attached our SOC 2 summary and a blank MAP template link to get started. If it helps, we can do a 30-min sync tomorrow to align owners.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Enterprise Sales (Security)
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPDocs

Cc: Tanya Singh <tanya.singh@lighthousebank.com>, Legal Counsel <legal@lighthousebank.com>, security@lighthousebank.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security questionnaire & retention clarifications

Thanks Irene — helpful. A few follow-ups from Legal: 

- Retention baseline: Legal is pushing for a firm statement of retention for customer PII and audit logs. They suggested (a) short-term operational logs 90 days, (b) long-term archives up to 7 years if requested, with access controls and egress protections. Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to that pattern?
- KV cache: they’re concerned about cached inference contexts that could contain PII. Is there an opt-out on per-customer basis to disable caching or limit cache TTL to near-zero?
- DPA scheduling: Legal wants to put a DocuSign DPA on the MAP with a target signature date — can Redwood commit to DPA routing to legal by Sep 30 so our internal SLAs can proceed?

Attaching Legal_Retention_Reqs.pdf for context. We want these items reflected as milestones in the MAP spreadsheet.

—Alex

Attachment: Legal_Retention_Reqs.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lighthousebank.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security questionnaire & retention clarifications

Alex / team — quick technical clarifications from Security/Infra: 

1) Retention commitments
- Operational logs (audit / access logs): default retention 30 days; we can extend to 90 days by configuration and include as a MAP deliverable. For long-term archival (7 years) we can provide export pipelines to customer-owned S3 or an encrypted archive; Redwood would treat this as a paid add-on (storage + export tooling).

2) KV cache and inference contexts
- Default behavior: KV cache is per-container and TTL-bound. For hosted API, default TTL is 0–4 hours depending on the model footprint; we do not persist full request bodies in KV beyond the TTL.
- Opt-outs: yes — we support a per-API-key toggle to disable KV caching and a zero-ttl mode for high-sensitivity customers. We’ll add a short runbook describing how to enable this for your PoC.

3) Data residency / subprocessors
- We can map subprocessors and provide a residency matrix. For Dedicated/Private: customer-managed infra stays in-customer control (we provide config and deployable artifacts).

4) Evidence / SIG mapping plan
- We’ll deliver a CAIQ mapping (tagging row -> evidence link or narrative) in 3 business days. Evidence bundle will include: SOC 2 summary, control diagrams, subprocessor list, configuration guide for retention and KV toggles, and sample audit logs (redacted).

Next steps:
- Marcus: please share the MAP spreadsheet with milestones: DPA to Legal (target Sep 30), CAIQ pass (target Sep 24), SOC2 evidence delivered (Sep 24), PoC finish (Oct 8), PO target (Oct 29).
- Irene: I’ll prepare the runbook and evidence links and attach them to the MAP.

Thanks — happy to sync if we need to walk Legal through the technical details live.

Naomi Feldman
Security & Trust Engineering
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
